_doc: Optional eng-os packs. The core (every other skill and rule) is always installed; a pack is installed only when the company selects it at install (`eng-os install --packs=...`, kept in ~/.claude/eng-os/company.json). The hooks name and insert only installed skills. `label` is used in the global CLAUDE.md's description of the company's work.
